title: Accuracy of an estimate trace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\tau\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\tau\leq 1$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let a trace be a finite list of estimate records. The trace is accurate for $f$ at threshold $\tau$ if every record in it has estimate differing from the restricted Fourier weight of $f$ on its recorded coordinate set and frequency prefix by less than $\tau^2/4$.
hypotheses_covered: Target is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
